title: 2020 in Review
summary:
Highly motivated selling was short-lived,
essentially limited to the month of March, and we never saw the full-throated panic,
accompanied by margin calls, meltdowns, and forced selling witnessed in p Risk tolerance returned, and fear of missing out took over from fear of losing money. The combination of this extra
disposable income with the ending of a prolonged period of isolation and release of pent-up
demand has the potential to add substantially to short-term economic growth.
